newsitem.title: BULGARIA: British firms plan gas supplies for Bulgarian city.
newsitem.headline: British firms plan gas supplies for Bulgarian city.

text.p: Ten British companies led by Amec Utilities Plc will carry out a $600,000 study for a project to convert parts of Bulgaria's second city, Plovdiv to using gas for heat and industrial power.
A British embassy statement said the project, to be launched by the consortium and the Plovdiv municipality on March 11, aimed to reduce pollution and improve energy efficiency.
It said Amec hoped to establish a gas company in conjunction with the municipality which would support the gas supply project and the possibilities it offered for local industry.

Municipality officials and managers of Plovdiv companies will travel to Britain to see how the gas network operates there and to make contact with British firms, and the embassy said it hoped Britain would also supply specialists.
